Name: De-Fabioed Elliott
Author: outrAJeous
Description:
So, I could never bring myself to marry Elliott because I absolutely hated the way he looked. It reminds me of an off brand Fabio or something. To solve this, I just changed [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/657]Sam and the Great Haircut[/url] mod that Thalabee already did and changed the sprites to do the things Elliott does. I also changed hair color to Elliott's color and the collar on the portrait because I hated the popped collar look. Hope you enjoy. Feel free to change the clothes and face in any way you like. I'd love to see someone give him hipster clothes, a beard, or even glasses. Unfortunately, I am not too great at portraits.  

There is a version with a blue jacket, as well as the original red colored jacket. I also threw in a bonus blue jacket version with black hair (Sebastian's hair color).
